segments.english: Kenan lived seventy years, and he fathered Mahalalel.
segments.literal: and-lived Kenan seventy year and-fathered [obj] Mahalalel

tokens.note: wayyiqtol of חיה: narrative sequence, 'and he lived'
singular שָׁנָה after the tens is idiomatic; here the plural-sense 'years'
wayyiqtol Hifil of ילד: of a father, 'beget'

phrases.literal: 'and-lived Kenan'; verb before subject in narrative

grammar: וַיְחִי is a wayyiqtol: the verb opens the sentence and the subject follows.
The etnaḥta on שָׁנָה divides the verse after the age.
הוֹלִיד is Hifil of ילד, used of the father: 'beget'.
segments.note: Standard genealogical formula of Genesis 5; the second clause names the son by the Hifil of ילד.

commentary.summary: Onkelos renders the verse closely, with the Aramaic וַחֲיָא for וַיְחִי and וְאוֹלִיד for וַיּוֹלֶד; no difference in sense.

segments.english: After he fathered Mahalalel, Kenan lived eight hundred and forty years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
segments.literal: and-lived Kenan after fathering-him [obj] Mahalalel forty year and-eight hundreds year and-fathered sons and-daughters

tokens.note: wayyiqtol of חיה: narrative sequence, 'and he lived'
infinitive construct Hifil with 3ms suffix: 'his begetting'; rendered 'he fathered'
מֵאוֹת, plural of מֵאָה; the pack lists only sense 3 for the entry, but the sense here is the cardinal 'hundred'

phrases.literal: 'after fathering-him [obj] Mahalalel'; infinitive construct with suffix as temporal clause
'forty year and-eight hundreds year'; the Hebrew states the tens first

phrases.english: and he fathered sons and daughters

grammar: אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ is a preposition with an infinitive construct and subject suffix: 'after his begetting'.
The number is given in the order forty, then eight hundred; the English reorders to eight hundred and forty.
The revia on קֵינָן and pashta on אַחֲרֵי mark the temporal clause.
בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת: sons and daughters, unnumbered.
segments.note: The clause 'after he fathered' was moved to the front in English as a natural time clause.

commentary.summary: Onkelos gives בָּתַר דְּאוֹלִיד and the number as eight hundred and forty, with בְּנִין וּבְנָן for sons and daughters; it agrees with the plain sense.

segments.english: All the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
segments.literal: and-were all-of days-of Kenan ten years and-nine hundred year and-died

tokens.note: wayyiqtol plural of היה; 'were' in the sense of totalling
מֵאוֹת; the pack lists only sense 3, but the sense is the cardinal 'hundred'

phrases.english: All the days of Kenan were

phrases.literal: 'ten years and-nine hundred year'; tens before hundreds

grammar: כָּל־יְמֵי קֵינָן is a construct chain: 'all the days of Kenan'.
עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים: ten, with plural 'years'; the larger number follows with singular שָׁנָה.
וַיָּמֹת is the wayyiqtol of מות with the short form.
The paragraph mark ס closes the entry for Kenan.
segments.note: The total 910 is the sum of 70, 840 (the 70 before the son plus 840 after).

commentary.summary: Onkelos has nine hundred and ten years and וּמִית 'and he died'; same sense.

segments.english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and he fathered Jared.
segments.literal: and-lived Mahalalel five years and-sixty year and-fathered [obj] Jared

tokens.note: wayyiqtol of חיה: narrative sequence, 'and he lived'
name; the pack gives the lemma as 'Jared'

phrases.literal: 'five years and-sixty year'; units before tens

grammar: The units precede the tens: חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, 'five years and sixty years'.
וַיּוֹלֶד is a Hifil wayyiqtol.
The etnaḥta on שָׁנָה ends the age clause.

commentary.summary: Onkelos has sixty-five years and יָרֶד; no difference.

segments.english: After he fathered Jared, Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty years, and he fathered sons and daughters.
segments.literal: and-lived Mahalalel after fathering-him [obj] Jared thirty year and-eight hundreds year and-fathered sons and-daughters

phrases.english: and he fathered sons and daughters

grammar: אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ: preposition plus infinitive construct with suffix, 'after his begetting'.
The number order is tens, then hundreds; the English reorders.
The revia on מַהֲלַלְאֵל separates subject from the time clause.

commentary.summary: Onkelos has eight hundred and thirty years and sons and daughters; agrees.

segments.english: All the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.
segments.literal: and-were all-of days-of Mahalalel five and-ninety year and-eight hundreds year and-died

tokens.note: מֵאוֹת; the pack lists only sense 3, but the sense is the cardinal 'hundred'

grammar: כָּל־יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל is a construct chain.
The age is written units, tens, hundreds: five and ninety, and eight hundred.
The mahpakh on חָמֵשׁ and pashta on וְתִשְׁעִים subdivide the number.
The paragraph mark ס closes the entry for Mahalalel.

commentary.summary: Onkelos has eight hundred and ninety-five years and וּמִית; agrees.
